# Autonomous Agent Instructions (UI 视觉精修 + 连载小说疏密叙事版)

Always follow the perpetual autonomous development loop defined in [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) and execute tasks sequentially from the top-most unchecked `- [ ]` item in [`BACKLOG.md`](../BACKLOG.md) (`[UI1-1]` -> `[UI1-5]` -> `[N1-1]` -> `[N1-5]` -> `Phase 18` -> `Phase 19` -> `Phase 20`). Never stop after one task—verify with `npm run verify`, update `BACKLOG.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`, commit and push to `origin main` (and redeploy the live preview site when available), and immediately start the next task.
